notes: Inbound from Playstore support request -> website signup -> trial request.
Primary app: casual multiplayer social game with persistent lobbies; text chat + reactions + support bot.
Use-case priorities: very low output latency for chat, high availability during evening peaks, robust automated abuse filtering.
Dev quote: "We need <100ms perceived latency for player chat or it feels laggy — willing to compromise on cost a bit but not on speed."
Current infra: AWS-only, fronted by CDN and Node.js chat servers; prefer public cloud hosted API for speed to market.
Traffic profile: steady 40-60 rps daytime, spikes up to ~150 rps at peak events (15-20 min bursts).
Moderation ask: sample false positive / false negative rate on short aggressive messages; need plug-and-play heuristics + custom blocklist support.
Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, looking for predictable per-message price; worried about unpredictable token spikes from long chats.
Security: asking for audit log proof and retention controls; not asking for Private deployment yet but want log export and simple retention settings.
POC success criteria: 1) median token latency <120ms; 2) moderation recall on flagged test set >85%; 3) predictable cost estimate for monthly usage ~1M messages.
Stated timeline: want to decide on hosted API by April to include in Q2 event rollout.
Action items: SE to drop quickstart, moderation examples, and small demo script; AE to confirm trial billing guardrails.
